items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 July 2026 7:57am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 17 July 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, extending a ridge across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less in places throughout, otherwise Mainly North or Northeast 3 or 4 occasionally 5, backing mainly North to Northwest this evening, then increasing 5 or 6 through the North Channel and towards central areas later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4 in the east, but North or Northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west, becoming North or Northwest 3 to 5 in all waters tomorrow afternoon. Veering North or Northeast 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight in the east, but slight or moderate in the west, becoming slight occasionally moderate in all waters tomorrow afternoon, the slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
